prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person with short silver hair wearing a black long-sleeve shirt with 'FG' on the chest and black shorts"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07"].

message.content: {"matches":["P03"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"P03 is the only person with short silver hair, wearing a black long-sleeve shirt with 'FG' visible on the chest, and black shorts. All other individuals either have different hair color, different clothing, or lack the specific 'FG' logo and shorts combination."}

parsed.reason: P03 is the only person with short silver hair, wearing a black long-sleeve shirt with 'FG' visible on the chest, and black shorts. All other individuals either have different hair color, different clothing, or lack the specific 'FG' logo and shorts combination.
